brief:
Israeli demolitions and road closures have inflicted severe damage on businesses throughout Hebron, Al Jazeera English reported. Shop owners face substantial financial losses as the military operations have destroyed commercial infrastructure across the city.

The combined effect of demolitions and access restrictions has crippled economic activity in the Palestinian city. Business owners described their situation as catastrophic, with many unable to assess full damages or resume operations.
dek: Israeli demolitions and road closures have devastated businesses in Hebron, leaving owners facing millions in losses.
title: Israeli demolitions devastate Hebron businesses, owners count millions in losses
